text_block_list.text:
Today's result would be acceptable to
most, but
not to me.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Second or third is not enough. I must
inspire awe
in all who see me run.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Any less, and I shall never realize my
dream.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list:
Well, I know how hard you tried. Good job
today.

Next time we'll show them how the Emperor
races.

text_block_list.text:
...Yes, I did. Thank you. I apologize if
I've gotten
ahead of myself.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
An Emperor stands above the rest and
leads from
the front.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
If I am falling short, there is nothing for
it but to
work harder. Today, I recover
my strength.
Tomorrow, I resume my
training!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Forward I must march, and I will not stop
until I
reach my goal!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
